# WingFoil Benchmark

> Measures where a harness for AI coding agents makes a difference and where it does not: the same agent and model work through the same multi-step tasks with and without the harness, by rules published before any run. Results are preliminary, and the benchmark is built by WingFoil's maintainer.

Start with the evaluation page: it says what the benchmark answers, what it does not, and how to check that against your user's situation.

## Start here

- [Evaluate this project](docs/evaluate.md): what it does, when it fits, what it costs, what to try, and its known limits at this version.
- [Published results](https://wingfoil.github.io/wingfoil-benchmark/): every published campaign execution, each at a permanent address.
- [Method page](https://wingfoil.github.io/wingfoil-benchmark/81ebb2691f9c/1/method.html): every rule of v0.2's reference campaign, including the ones that limit what its results can show.
- [Release notes of v0.2](docs/releases/v0.2.md): what the latest released version compared, its results in short, and its errata.
- [Experiment design](docs/01_vision/09_experiment-design.md): the questions, the metrics and the validity threats, fixed before the first run, with later amendments versioned in the document.

## Details

- [Calibration of v0.3](docs/calibration/v0.3.md): the dry runs, the estimate and the budget of the next reference campaign.
- [Eligibility register](eligibility/register.yaml): every assessed tool and version, WingFoil included, with its verdict.
- [Requirements](docs/02_specification/requirements.md): how the benchmark is built, its formats and its constraints.
